name: je-pension-contributions
description: Jersey pension-holder contribution deductions under Article 131I, checked for 2026 against current law and Revenue Jersey guidance. Use for approved Jersey pension contributions, relevant earnings, the annual deduction cap or the higher-income restriction. Covers holder-paid occupational pension, retirement annuity and retirement trust contributions with aggregate limits, classified income inputs and worked examples. Requires confirmation of scheme approval, the assessment year and each income source before calculation. Overseas schemes, employer deductions, salary sacrifice, withdrawals and transfers require separate advice. This source-cited draft awaits professional review; the deduction is not the amount of tax saved.
